title: AIWorkflow
description: Schema-driven AI workflow definition. Storage: a single JSON file per workflow. The engine is a pure state machine; task nodes are executed by an external AI agent.

id.description: Globally unique workflow id, also the definition file name.

default_model.description: Hint for the executing agent about which model to use. The engine itself never calls a model.

max_steps.description: Hard guard against infinite branch loops.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft-07) validated against run inputs at startup; required keys MUST be provided.

exports.description: Context keys (with optional JSON Schema snippets) returned to the parent when this workflow runs as a subflow. Absent = parent gets status only.

edges.description: Connections between nodes. If omitted, nodes are chained in array order.

glob.description: fnmatch pattern matched against $file output paths, e.g. novel/chapters/*.md

default.description: Used when the context key is absent.

review_config.description: Embedded human acceptance check attached to a task node.

requirements.description: Acceptance criteria shown to the reviewer. Templates allowed: ${var}.

routes.description: Optional verdict routing: APPROVE/REJECT -> node id. Defaults: APPROVE follows edges (null), REJECT redoes this node.

inputs_mapping.description: Mapping of child input keys to values; string values support ${var} templates rendered in the parent context.

items_source.description: foreach items: a literal array, {var} from parent context, or {$file}. An array means static mode; an object {"done":bool,"items":[...]} means dynamic mode.

exports_map.description: Export key -> optional JSON Schema snippet used to validate the export at completion.

name.description: Human readable name shown in audit records.

prompt.description: [task|branch] Prompt template referencing context via ${var}. Rendered by the engine before served.

model.description: [task|branch] Model hint for the executing agent; overrides default_model. The engine never calls it.

input_schema.description: [task] JSON Schema (draft-07) for information collected FROM THE USER at this node. Missing required keys pause the run until provided.

consumes.description: [task] Explicit data dependencies for cascade revisions: context keys, or {glob} matched against $file paths. Needed when consumption happens by reading files rather than ${var} in the prompt.

output_key.description: [task|subflow] Context key storing the result. Defaults to node id.

output_schema.description: [task] JSON Schema (draft-07) the reported output MUST satisfy; non-conforming output is rejected and the node stays open.

review.description: [task] Require human acceptance after execution before advancing.

routes.description: [branch] answer label -> target node id (TRUE/FALSE for when branches); [review standalone] verdict -> target node id.

default.description: [branch] Target node id when the answer matches no route.

when.description: [branch] Deterministic condition evaluated by the engine against context; result routes via TRUE/FALSE. No LLM call.

workflow.description: [subflow|foreach] Id of the workflow definition to invoke. foreach: mutually exclusive with nodes.

inputs.description: [subflow|foreach] Values passed into the child; rendered against parent context (foreach also exposes item/index).

nodes.description: [foreach inline] Body nodes; mutually exclusive with workflow. Edges optional (chained if omitted); start/end are added automatically.

edges.description: [foreach inline] Internal edges of the body. Overrides order chaining.

as.description: [foreach] Child context key receiving the current item. Defaults: item.

index_as.description: [foreach] Child context key receiving the current index. Defaults: index.

outputs_key.description: [foreach] Context key receiving the {$file} results manifest. Defaults to node id.

exports.description: [foreach inline] Exports: array of keys or key->schema map.

on_fail.description: [foreach] abort: parent fails on a failed instance (resume retries); continue: keep going, failures stay in the manifest.

max_instances.description: [foreach] Fan-out cap to protect dynamic sources.

id_field.description: [foreach] For object items: field providing the stable instance key.
